parties: Equivas Capital Pvt Ltd; Equippp Social Impact Technologies Limited
headline: Equivas Capital files SEBI Takeover Regulation disclosure for Equippp Social Impact Technologies
sum: Equivas Capital Pvt Ltd has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code, signalling a substantial acquisition or interest in Equippp Social Impact Technologies Limited. The filing is the mandatory disclosure gateway for acquirers crossing the 25% threshold or intending a takeover.
implication: SEBI Reg. 31(4) is the statutory trigger for detailed disclosures of intent, funding, and conditions precedent; partners must verify whether this is a creeping acquisition, open offer requirement, or negotiated deal under exemption.
detail: Equivas Capital Pvt Ltd submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, concerning Equippp Social Impact Technologies Limited. This disclosure is mandatory when an acquirer either (a) acquires or proposes to acquire shares carrying 25% or more of voting rights, or (b) acquires control. The filing does not yet reveal the acquisition quantum, offer price, funding source, or deal structure; those details typically appear in the full disclosure document or subsequent open offer announcement.
